title: Tighten the release-workflow verify-gate tests (WCLI-122 round-2 LOWs)
description: Not a flip gate. LOW findings of the round-2 Opus review of opum-ai/ward-cli#234 (merged), to land before the flip only if time allows, under its own small PR and review: (2) measured: a command substitution inside the notice echo stays green, so pin the notice step run text literally with toBe; (3) assert the verify job download-artifact uses equals the release job download-artifact uses, so a paired SHA bump survives; (4) deep-equal parsed.on, parsed.permissions and the release job needs, if and permissions in the parsed view.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The notice step run text is asserted with toBe, and a command substitution added to it turns a test red
The verify job and release job download-artifact uses values are asserted equal
parsed.on, parsed.permissions and the release job needs, if and permissions are deep-equalled in the parsed view
